text: Freeze the required first-level inventory at the candidate: first-level.yml jobs full-repository, focused-first-level and scientific-coverage. API status-context names should be read from the matching recorded CI jobs (human names currently: full repository JVM/Scala.js compile and test; focused first-level JVM/Scala.js gates; scoped first-level scientific coverage). Require all three in effective branch/ruleset policy; no automatic policy changes. Distinguish a missing requirement from an API-permission blocker. If a maintainer changes the supported policy, record that as an explicit updated decision rather than weakening this collector ad hoc.
